subject: Singles Day
hook: SINGLES DAY IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Singles' Day is not just a holiday for people without partners; it has become an event where many participants actively engage in rituals to find a spouse or partner, effectively functioning as a mass matchmaking festival.
angle_support: Blind date parties are popular on this day, in an attempt to alter the single status of the participants.
Although this date is meant to celebrate singlehood, the desire to find a spouse or partner is often expressed by young Chinese people on this date
title: Singles' Day: China’s Secret Mass Matchmaking Festival
description: While most think Singles' Day just celebrates being unattached, it’s actually a massive social event where blind‑date parties aim to pair up participants. The tradition grew from a university celebration into a nationwide matchmaking phenomenon.
narration: SINGLES DAY IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture Singles' Day as merely a celebration for people without partners. In reality, it’s a huge matchmaking festival packed with blind‑date parties and rituals to find a spouse. The holiday was born in 1993 at Nanjing University and today includes organized blind‑date parties, where thousands of singles gather specifically to meet a partner, turning the day into a nationwide matchmaking event. Every year, love seekers flood the sales floor for a chance at romance.
